gateDecision.rationale: All seven independent evaluation metrics meet threshold, no semantically available carrier remains unchecked, and the independent meta-audit found no unguarded carrier, meaning change, or relationship. This independent pass does not override the separate canonical deterministic validator result, which failed 2 of 22 internal contract gates. The audit's fail_requires_correction verdict describes the source video's misleading claims; the repaired reconstruction accurately preserves and bounds those conflicts rather than repeating them as facts.

deterministicGate.rationale: CAR-NONSPEECH-AUDIO is semantically inspected but its modalityKeys do not contain the validator-recognized non_speech_audio form, and KU-08's 5.18-8.66 range cites OCR-00107/OCR-00108 from the later Act-Two UI interval. The candidate was not modified.

evidenceCoverage.denominatorRule: The independent audit was decomposed into 28 non-duplicated core facts across scope/role samples, Act-One versus Act-Two identity, Gen-4 promo status, visible inputs and result state, operation and lineage gaps, continuous motion, unsupported one-sentence editing, subtitle conflicts, audio, and authorization/access boundaries.

unsupportedInference.denominatorRule: The check covers 40 distinct structured positive propositions: one scope proposition, 27 knowledge-unit statements, and 12 explicit relation statements. Repeated report prose was not double-counted.

unknownDiscipline.denominatorRule: Material unknown opportunities were separated by decision boundary: universal role scope, exact identities, asset/likeness rights, presenter-driver mapping, sample and output lineage, selection/click/generation/wait/export operations, generation time, synchronization accuracy/latency, hidden cuts, one-sentence input mechanism, P图/批图 spelling, music/SFX provenance, access/price/account/region/support, product version, and the cause of the Act-One mislabel.

judgeRationale.readability: The report is clearly staged from promotional promise through UI, result player and closing output, though dense for a 22.5-second source.
judgeRationale.knowledgePrioritization: The Act-One/Act-Two contradiction, Gen-4 promo boundary, completed result state and missing operation/lineage bridges are placed first and kept distinct.
judgeRationale.evidenceUsefulness: The reconstruction supplies exact UI copy, frame-sequence evidence, bounded negative checks, subtitle conflicts and a full-track audio inspection with conservative interpretation.
judgeRationale.executionValue: A reader can identify the visible two-input structure and what must still be verified before treating it as a reproducible workflow; the source does not provide the missing execution itself.
judgeRationale.compressionWithoutLoss: No decisive audit nuance is lost, but some repeated caveats and role descriptions could be compressed.

metaAudit.rationale: Independent review covered speech, verbatim SRT, burned captions, UI/OCR, presenter picture-in-picture, multi-role motion montage, Act-Two result-player motion, closing continuous motion, layout/count, recognizable symbols, full-track non-speech audio, and bounded full-timeline negative evidence. It explicitly guarded the Act-One/Act-Two carrier conflict, Gen-4 promo-versus-active-mode distinction, player result versus generation-time distinction, edited adjacency versus input/output lineage, split-screen correspondence versus causality, opening universal promise versus one closing result, SRT/hard-caption/ASR conflicts, and technical segmentation versus semantic continuity. A fresh evaluator-side AST pass on three contiguous windows of the source independently confirmed speech and music in every window; low and unstable transient candidates were not promoted to sound-effect facts. The candidate's own metaGate was not used as proof.

residuals: CAR-NONSPEECH-AUDIO modalityKeys are not machine-recognizable as the non-speech-audio carrier required by the canonical validator.
KU-08's declared interval does not contain OCR-00107/OCR-00108, even though the later UI evidence is relevant to its interpretation.
discrepancySummary.details: The repaired candidate matches the independent audit on all material facts and uncertainty boundaries, but two deterministic internal-contract gaps remain.
